burst_concurrent_8inst.description: Burst 8-instance concurrent — PCIe DMA contention destroys PegaFlow benefit
burst_concurrent_8inst.root_cause: 8 concurrent DMA streams saturate PCIe uplink
burst_concurrent_8inst.verdict: Burst is unrealistic workload; staggered/normal serving load unaffected

mla_tp8_deepseek_v2_lite.description: DeepSeek-V2-Lite MLA+TP8 — prefill too cheap for PegaFlow to matter
mla_tp8_deepseek_v2_lite.root_cause: MLA kv_lora_rank=512 compresses KV compute to ~100ms; DMA of compressed KV ~3ms
mla_tp8_deepseek_v2_lite.verdict: PegaFlow requires large enough prefill gap to overcome DMA cost
